Journal of Geophysical Research  doi:10.1029/2003JE002048

This electronic supplement contains some maps of the variance
associated with our preferred solution, as well as the covariance map
for the dominant eigenvalue. We also included our solutions, and the
code one can use to compute magnetic observations at a given altitude.

Maps

The M23/-20/14 model exhibits a single dominant eigenvector, carrying
60% of the variance. The figures [2003JE002048_cov_Mr.gif],
[2003JE002048_cov_Mt.gif], and [2003JE002048_cov_Mp.gif] represent the
covariance maps of this dominant eigenvector. The figures
[2003JE002048_sig_Mr.gif], [2003JE002048_sig_Mt.gif], and
[2003JE002048_sig_Mp.gif] are the formal error maps of our solutions,
for all three components.

\section{Code and solution}

The file [2003JE002048_solutionM23.-20.14] contain the dipole
solution M23/-20/14. The file [2003JE002048_forward-code.c]
contains a C code. It can be used together with the solution to
compute magnetic components at a given altitude.
